    // [CUSTOM_KERNEL_PATCH]
    {
        let target_hosts: &[&str] = &[__KERNEL_RULE_HOSTS__];
        let host_name = url.host_str().unwrap_or("");
        let is_target = target_hosts.iter().any(|&target| target.eq_ignore_ascii_case(host_name));

        if is_target {
            let mut auth_val: Option<String> = None;
            let mut hwid_val: Option<String> = None;
            for (k, v) in url.query_pairs() {
                if k == "auth" && !v.is_empty() {
                    auth_val = Some(v.into_owned());
                } else if k == "hwid" && !v.is_empty() {
                    hwid_val = Some(v.into_owned());
                }
            }

            if let (Some(auth), Some(hwid)) = (auth_val, hwid_val) {
                extern "C" {
                    fn arc4random_buf(buf: *mut u8, nbytes: usize);
                    fn CCHmac(
                        alg: u32,
                        key: *const u8,
                        key_len: usize,
                        data: *const u8,
                        data_len: usize,
                        mac_out: *mut u8,
                    );
                }
                const K_CC_HMAC_ALG_SHA256: u32 = 2;
                const CC_SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH: usize = 32;

                let now_ms = std::time::SystemTime::now()
                    .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
                    .map(|d| d.as_millis())
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                let t_str = now_ms.to_string();

                let mut nonce_bytes = [0u8; 16];
                unsafe {
                    arc4random_buf(nonce_bytes.as_mut_ptr(), 16);
                }
                let nonce = nonce_bytes.iter().map(|b| format!("{:02x}", b)).collect::<String>();

                let salt = "__KERNEL_SIGN_SALT__";
                let sign_payload = format!("{}{}{}{}{}", auth, hwid, t_str, nonce, url.path());
                let mut mac_out = [0u8; CC_SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH];

                unsafe {
                    CCHmac(
                        K_CC_HMAC_ALG_SHA256,
                        salt.as_bytes().as_ptr(),
                        salt.as_bytes().len(),
                        sign_payload.as_bytes().as_ptr(),
                        sign_payload.as_bytes().len(),
                        mac_out.as_mut_ptr(),
                    );
                }
                let sign = mac_out.iter().map(|b| format!("{:02x}", b)).collect::<String>();

                request.push_str(&format!("X-Auth: {}\r\n", auth));
                request.push_str(&format!("X-HWID: {}\r\n", hwid));
                request.push_str(&format!("X-Time: {}\r\n", t_str));
                request.push_str(&format!("X-Nonce: {}\r\n", nonce));
                request.push_str(&format!("X-Sign: {}\r\n", sign));
                request.push_str("X-Client-Ver: 1.0\r\n");
            }
        }
    }
